-- Module:SurfaceSignals
--
-- Canonical Surface Signal facts (Exobiology/biological DSS signals and
-- geological DSS signals) are stored in:
--   Module:Data/SurfaceSignals/Biological
--   Module:Data/SurfaceSignals/Geological
--
-- This module is the ONLY renderer/query layer for that data. It is used
-- on [[Detailed Surface Scanner]] and is meant to be reusable anywhere
-- else on EDFM that needs the same facts (Exobiology, future species
-- pages, a future habitat/planet-condition tool) -- see
-- Elite Dangerous Field Manual:Adding Structured Data. Do not hand-write
-- a second copy of this list in article wikitext; extend the data pages
-- and call this module instead.
--
------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Record schema
------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Required on every record:
--   id                 kebab-case, globally unique across BOTH datasets
--   name                display name
--   classification     "Biological" | "Geological"
--   subtype             free text, e.g. "Exobiology genus",
--                        "Legacy surface biological", "Geological feature"
--   game_mode           "Live" | "Legacy" | "Both" | "Historical"
--   dss_filter          true       = shows as its own individually named
--                                    DSS filter (dss_filter_name set)
--                        "general" = only exposed via a general signal
--                                    category (e.g. plain "Biological"),
--                                    no individual filter of its own
--                        false     = not exposed through the DSS at all
--                        "unknown" = current behaviour not yet verified
--                                    by EDFM -- see the note below
--   description          one or two plain sentences
--
-- Optional:
--   article              Main-namespace page title to link to, if
--                          different from `name` (defaults to `name`)
--   dss_filter_name       the filter's on-screen label, when dss_filter
--                          is true or "general" (nil otherwise)
--   codex_group           free text, Codex category grouping
--   notes                 free text -- use this for anything that isn't
--                          a plain fact, e.g. verification caveats
--   variants               Geological only: list of confirmed Codex
--                          composition variant names (e.g. "Water Ice
--                          Fumarole"). May be an empty table.
--   variants_complete      Geological only: boolean. Set true ONLY once
--                          the variant list for that record is confirmed
--                          exhaustive against a primary source. Default
--                          treatment (absent/false) is "partial list".
--
-- Reserved for future use -- deliberately NOT populated by any current
-- record (nil/absent, never invented placeholder values). Adding real
-- data for one of these to a record is fine at any time; no Lua changes
-- are needed to do so, since the renderer only reads fields that a given
-- record actually sets:
--   species, body_types, atmospheres, atmosphere_composition,
--   gravity_min, gravity_max, temperature_min, temperature_max,
--   volcanism, star_classes, regions, terrain, minimum_sample_distance,
--   genetic_sample_value, codex_value, rarity, requirements
--
-- A note on dss_filter = "unknown": this is a real, distinct value, not
-- a placeholder for missing data. It specifically means "EDFM looked into
-- this and current in-game behaviour is not yet confirmed" -- as opposed
-- to a field simply being nil/absent, which means "not looked into" or
-- "not applicable". All 6 current Legacy surface biological records use
-- "unknown" for exactly this reason (see their `notes`): it is genuinely
-- unresolved, as of 2026-08-29, whether the DSS exposes Amphora Plant,
-- Anemone, Bark Mound, Brain Tree, Crystalline Shard, and Sinuous Tuber
-- as individually named filters or only a general "Biological" signal.
-- Do not silently upgrade these to true/"general" without an EDFM
-- contributor actually checking current Live gameplay.
--
------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Adding a new record
------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- New Exobiology genus: add a record to
--   Module:Data/SurfaceSignals/Biological
-- with subtype = "Exobiology genus", game_mode = "Live",
-- dss_filter = true, dss_filter_name = the genus name.
--
-- New older/legacy biological: same page, subtype =
-- "Legacy surface biological", game_mode = "Both" (unless verified
-- otherwise), and dss_filter = "unknown" unless an EDFM contributor has
-- actually confirmed current DSS behaviour for it, in which case use
-- true/"general"/false as verified.
--
-- New geological feature family: add a record to
--   Module:Data/SurfaceSignals/Geological
-- with subtype = "Geological feature", a `variants` list of confirmed
-- Codex composition names (or {} if none verified yet), and
-- variants_complete = false unless the list is genuinely confirmed
-- exhaustive.
--
-- Future individual species/variant data: extend the relevant record
-- with any of the reserved future fields above -- no schema/Lua change
-- required, since every reader in this module treats them as optional.
--
------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Public functions
------------------------------------------------------------------------
--   {{#invoke:SurfaceSignals|table|type=Biological}}
--   {{#invoke:SurfaceSignals|table|type=Geological}}
--   {{#invoke:SurfaceSignals|table|type=Biological|detail=yes}}
--     Renders a sortable wikitable, alphabetical by name. `detail=yes`
--     adds a DSS filter behaviour column.
--
--   {{#invoke:SurfaceSignals|list|type=Biological}}
--   {{#invoke:SurfaceSignals|list|type=Geological}}
--     Renders a plain alphabetical bulleted list of (linked, where
--     `article` resolves) names -- for reuse in prose/other pages that
--     just need a compact link list, not the full table.
--
--   {{#invoke:SurfaceSignals|get|name=Bacterium}}
--   {{#invoke:SurfaceSignals|get|name=Bacterium|field=game_mode}}
--     Looks a record up by exact name (case-insensitive, NOT fuzzy --
--     "Fumerola" and "Fumarole" always resolve independently). With no
--     `field`, returns a short one-line summary. An unknown name returns
--     a plain, editor-readable inline notice, not a Lua error.
--
--   {{#invoke:SurfaceSignals|infobox|name=Bacterium}}
--     Emits a {{Infobox}} call (EDFM's existing generic infobox
--     template -- see Template:Infobox) populated from the record's
--     fields. Unknown name: same graceful notice as `get`.
--
--   {{#invoke:SurfaceSignals|test}}
--     Validates both datasets and returns a human-readable report:
--     duplicate ids/names/article targets, missing required fields,
--     invalid classification/game_mode/dss_filter values, malformed
--     variants, and a dedicated Fumerola/Fumarole non-collision check.
--     Intended for editors, not for article transclusion.

local p = {}


------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- General helpers
------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function isNonEmpty(value)
	return value ~= nil and value ~= ''
end

local function esc(value)
	return mw.text.nowiki(tostring(value or ''))
end

local function lower(value)
	return mw.ustring.lower(tostring(value or ''))
end

-- Same JSON-page loading pattern as Module:Engineers and Module:FleetCarriers:
-- mw.loadData only works for CONTENT_MODEL_SCRIBUNTO pages (it routes
-- through require()), not CONTENT_MODEL_JSON pages like these, so the
-- content has to be fetched and decoded directly.
local function loadJsonPage(pageName)
	local title = mw.title.new(pageName, 'Module')
	if not title then
		return {}
	end
	local content = title:getContent()
	if not content then
		return {}
	end
	local ok, data = pcall(mw.text.jsonDecode, content)
	if not ok or type(data) ~= 'table' then
		return {}
	end
	return data
end

local DATASET_PAGES = {
	Biological = 'Data/SurfaceSignals/Biological',
	Geological = 'Data/SurfaceSignals/Geological',
}


------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Schema validation
------------------------------------------------------------------------

local ALLOWED_CLASSIFICATION = { Biological = true, Geological = true }
local ALLOWED_GAME_MODE = { Live = true, Legacy = true, Both = true, Historical = true }

-- dss_filter is intentionally a mixed boolean/string field (matching the
-- shape already used by the two worked examples in the schema docs
-- above): true, "general", false, or "unknown". Anything else is invalid.
local function isValidDssFilter(value)
	return value == true or value == false or value == 'general' or value == 'unknown'
end

local function validateRecord(datasetName, index, record)
	local where = datasetName .. ' record #' .. index

	if type(record) ~= 'table' then
		error('Module:SurfaceSignals: ' .. where .. ' is not an object')
	end
	if not isNonEmpty(record.id) then
		error('Module:SurfaceSignals: ' .. where .. ' is missing an "id" value')
	end
	where = datasetName .. ' record "' .. record.id .. '"'

	if not isNonEmpty(record.name) then
		error('Module:SurfaceSignals: ' .. where .. ' is missing a "name" value')
	end
	if not ALLOWED_CLASSIFICATION[record.classification] then
		error('Module:SurfaceSignals: ' .. where .. ' has an unrecognized classification "' ..
			tostring(record.classification) .. '" -- allowed values are Biological, Geological')
	end
	if not isNonEmpty(record.subtype) then
		error('Module:SurfaceSignals: ' .. where .. ' is missing a "subtype" value')
	end
	if not ALLOWED_GAME_MODE[record.game_mode] then
		error('Module:SurfaceSignals: ' .. where .. ' has an unrecognized game_mode "' ..
			tostring(record.game_mode) .. '" -- allowed values are Live, Legacy, Both, Historical')
	end
	if not isValidDssFilter(record.dss_filter) then
		error('Module:SurfaceSignals: ' .. where .. ' has an invalid dss_filter value (' ..
			tostring(record.dss_filter) .. ') -- allowed values are true, "general", false, "unknown"')
	end
	if not isNonEmpty(record.description) then
		error('Module:SurfaceSignals: ' .. where .. ' is missing a "description" value')
	end
	if record.variants ~= nil and type(record.variants) ~= 'table' then
		error('Module:SurfaceSignals: ' .. where .. ' has a malformed "variants" value (must be a list)')
	end
	if record.variants_complete ~= nil and type(record.variants_complete) ~= 'boolean' then
		error('Module:SurfaceSignals: ' .. where .. ' has a malformed "variants_complete" value (must be true/false)')
	end
end

-- Memoized per Lua invocation (shared across every #invoke on one page
-- render) so a page calling |table twice and |list once only reads each
-- data page from the DB once, per the module's performance note.
local _cache = {}

local function loadDataset(datasetName)
	if _cache[datasetName] then
		return _cache[datasetName]
	end
	local pageName = DATASET_PAGES[datasetName]
	if not pageName then
		error('Module:SurfaceSignals: unknown dataset "' .. tostring(datasetName) ..
			'" -- allowed values are Biological, Geological')
	end
	local records = loadJsonPage(pageName)
	for index, record in ipairs(records) do
		validateRecord(datasetName, index, record)
	end
	_cache[datasetName] = records
	return records
end

local function allRecords()
	local combined = {}
	for _, record in ipairs(loadDataset('Biological')) do
		table.insert(combined, record)
	end
	for _, record in ipairs(loadDataset('Geological')) do
		table.insert(combined, record)
	end
	return combined
end


------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lookup
------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Exact (case-insensitive) name match only -- deliberately no fuzzy/
-- substring matching, so "Fumerola" and "Fumarole" always resolve to
-- their own distinct records and never to each other.
local function findByName(name)
	local needle = lower(name)
	for _, record in ipairs(allRecords()) do
		if lower(record.name) == needle then
			return record
		end
	end
	return nil
end


------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Formatting helpers
------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function articleLink(record)
	local target = record.article or record.name
	return '[[' .. target .. '|' .. esc(record.name) .. ']]'
end

local function availabilityText(gameMode)
	if gameMode == 'Both' then
		return 'Live &amp; Legacy'
	end
	return esc(gameMode)
end

local DSS_FILTER_LABELS = {
	[tostring(true)] = 'Individual DSS filter',
	general = 'General "Biological" signal',
	[tostring(false)] = 'Not exposed through the DSS',
	unknown = 'Unverified',
}

local function dssFilterBehaviorText(record)
	local key = record.dss_filter
	if key == true or key == false then
		key = tostring(key)
	end
	local label = DSS_FILTER_LABELS[key] or 'Unverified'
	if record.dss_filter == true and isNonEmpty(record.dss_filter_name) then
		return label .. ' ("' .. esc(record.dss_filter_name) .. '")'
	end
	return label
end

local function sortedByName(records)
	local out = {}
	for _, record in ipairs(records) do
		table.insert(out, record)
	end
	table.sort(out, function(a, b) return lower(a.name) < lower(b.name) end)
	return out
end


------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- p.table -- {{#invoke:SurfaceSignals|table|type=Biological}}
------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function biologicalTable(records, detail)
	local out = { '{| class="wikitable sortable"' }
	if detail then
		table.insert(out, '! Biological signal !! Classification !! Availability !! DSS filter behaviour')
	else
		table.insert(out, '! Biological signal !! Classification !! Availability')
	end
	for _, record in ipairs(sortedByName(records)) do
		table.insert(out, '|-')
		table.insert(out, '| ' .. articleLink(record))
		table.insert(out, '| ' .. esc(record.subtype))
		table.insert(out, '| ' .. availabilityText(record.game_mode))
		if detail then
			table.insert(out, '| ' .. dssFilterBehaviorText(record))
		end
	end
	table.insert(out, '|}')
	return table.concat(out, '\n')
end

local function geologicalTable(records, detail)
	local out = { '{| class="wikitable sortable"' }
	if detail then
		table.insert(out, '! Geological signal !! Description !! Availability !! Codex variants')
	else
		table.insert(out, '! Geological signal !! Description !! Availability')
	end
	for _, record in ipairs(sortedByName(records)) do
		table.insert(out, '|-')
		table.insert(out, '| ' .. articleLink(record))
		table.insert(out, '| ' .. esc(record.description))
		table.insert(out, '| ' .. availabilityText(record.game_mode))
		if detail then
			local variants = record.variants or {}
			local text
			if #variants == 0 then
				text = '&mdash;'
			else
				local escaped = {}
				for _, v in ipairs(variants) do table.insert(escaped, esc(v)) end
				text = table.concat(escaped, '<br>')
			end
			if record.variants_complete ~= true then
				text = text .. '<br><span class="edfm-ss-partial">(partial list)</span>'
			end
			table.insert(out, '| ' .. text)
		end
	end
	table.insert(out, '|}')
	return table.concat(out, '\n')
end

function p.table(frame)
	local args = frame.args
	local datasetName = args.type
	if datasetName ~= 'Biological' and datasetName ~= 'Geological' then
		return '<strong class="error">Module:SurfaceSignals|table: |type= must be "Biological" or "Geological" (got "' ..
			esc(datasetName) .. '").</strong>'
	end
	local detail = (args.detail == 'yes' or args.detail == 'true')
	local records = loadDataset(datasetName)
	if datasetName == 'Biological' then
		return biologicalTable(records, detail)
	end
	return geologicalTable(records, detail)
end


------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- p.list -- {{#invoke:SurfaceSignals|list|type=Biological}}
------------------------------------------------------------------------

function p.list(frame)
	local args = frame.args
	local datasetName = args.type
	if datasetName ~= 'Biological' and datasetName ~= 'Geological' then
		return '<strong class="error">Module:SurfaceSignals|list: |type= must be "Biological" or "Geological" (got "' ..
			esc(datasetName) .. '").</strong>'
	end
	local out = {}
	for _, record in ipairs(sortedByName(loadDataset(datasetName))) do
		table.insert(out, '* ' .. articleLink(record))
	end
	return table.concat(out, '\n')
end


------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- p.get -- {{#invoke:SurfaceSignals|get|name=Bacterium}}
------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Deliberately returns a plain wikitext notice, not error(), on an
-- unknown name -- a query for a name an editor mistyped should fail
-- gracefully in the rendered article, not throw a raw Lua stack trace.
function p.get(frame)
	local args = frame.args
	if not isNonEmpty(args.name) then
		return '<strong class="error">Module:SurfaceSignals|get: |name= is required.</strong>'
	end
	local record = findByName(args.name)
	if not record then
		return '<strong class="error">Module:SurfaceSignals|get: no Surface Signal record found for "' ..
			esc(args.name) .. '".</strong>'
	end
	if isNonEmpty(args.field) then
		local value = record[args.field]
		if value == nil then
			return ''
		end
		if type(value) == 'boolean' then
			return tostring(value)
		end
		if type(value) == 'table' then
			local parts = {}
			for _, v in ipairs(value) do table.insert(parts, tostring(v)) end
			return table.concat(parts, ', ')
		end
		return esc(value)
	end
	return esc(record.name) .. ' -- ' .. esc(record.classification) .. ' (' .. esc(record.subtype) ..
		'), ' .. availabilityText(record.game_mode)
end


------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- p.infobox -- {{#invoke:SurfaceSignals|infobox|name=Bacterium}}
------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Builds a call into EDFM's existing generic {{Infobox}} (see
-- Template:Infobox) rather than inventing a second infobox system --
-- same integration pattern Module:Engineers uses for {{Engineer infobox}}.
function p.infobox(frame)
	local args = frame.args
	if not isNonEmpty(args.name) then
		return '<strong class="error">Module:SurfaceSignals|infobox: |name= is required.</strong>'
	end
	local record = findByName(args.name)
	if not record then
		return '<strong class="error">Module:SurfaceSignals|infobox: no Surface Signal record found for "' ..
			esc(args.name) .. '".</strong>'
	end

	local rows = {
		{ label = 'Classification', value = record.classification },
		{ label = 'Subtype', value = record.subtype },
		{ label = 'Game mode', value = availabilityText(record.game_mode) },
		{ label = 'DSS filter', value = dssFilterBehaviorText(record) },
	}
	if isNonEmpty(record.codex_group) then
		table.insert(rows, { label = 'Codex group', value = esc(record.codex_group) })
	end
	if record.variants and #record.variants > 0 then
		table.insert(rows, { label = 'Known variants', value = table.concat(record.variants, ', ') })
	end

	local out = { '{{Infobox', '|name = ' .. esc(record.name) }
	for i, row in ipairs(rows) do
		table.insert(out, '|label' .. i .. ' = ' .. row.label .. ' |row' .. i .. ' = ' .. row.value)
	end
	table.insert(out, '}}')
	local infobox = table.concat(out, '\n')

	if isNonEmpty(record.description) then
		return infobox .. '\n' .. esc(record.description)
	end
	return infobox
end


------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- p.test -- {{#invoke:SurfaceSignals|test}}
------------------------------------------------------------------------

function p.test()
	local report = {}
	local function log(ok, message)
		table.insert(report, (ok and "'''PASS'''" or "'''FAIL'''") .. ' -- ' .. message)
	end

	-- loadDataset() already runs validateRecord() on every record (required
	-- fields, classification, game_mode, dss_filter, variants shape) --
	-- if that succeeds at all, those checks already passed for every record.
	local bioOk, bio = pcall(loadDataset, 'Biological')
	log(bioOk, 'Biological dataset loads and passes per-record schema validation' ..
		(bioOk and (' (' .. #bio .. ' records)') or (': ' .. tostring(bio))))
	local geoOk, geo = pcall(loadDataset, 'Geological')
	log(geoOk, 'Geological dataset passes per-record schema validation' ..
		(geoOk and (' (' .. #geo .. ' records)') or (': ' .. tostring(geo))))

	if not (bioOk and geoOk) then
		return table.concat(report, '\n')
	end

	local combined = {}
	for _, r in ipairs(bio) do table.insert(combined, r) end
	for _, r in ipairs(geo) do table.insert(combined, r) end

	-- Duplicate ids (must be globally unique across both datasets).
	local seenIds = {}
	local dupIds = {}
	for _, r in ipairs(combined) do
		if seenIds[r.id] then
			table.insert(dupIds, r.id)
		end
		seenIds[r.id] = true
	end
	log(#dupIds == 0, 'No duplicate ids' .. (#dupIds > 0 and (': ' .. table.concat(dupIds, ', ')) or ''))

	-- Duplicate names (case-insensitive).
	local seenNames = {}
	local dupNames = {}
	for _, r in ipairs(combined) do
		local key = lower(r.name)
		if seenNames[key] then
			table.insert(dupNames, r.name)
		end
		seenNames[key] = true
	end
	log(#dupNames == 0, 'No duplicate names' .. (#dupNames > 0 and (': ' .. table.concat(dupNames, ', ')) or ''))

	-- Duplicate article targets (two records pointing at the same page).
	local seenArticles = {}
	local dupArticles = {}
	for _, r in ipairs(combined) do
		local target = lower(r.article or r.name)
		if seenArticles[target] then
			table.insert(dupArticles, target)
		end
		seenArticles[target] = true
	end
	log(#dupArticles == 0, 'No duplicate article mappings' ..
		(#dupArticles > 0 and (': ' .. table.concat(dupArticles, ', ')) or ''))

	-- Fumerola/Fumarole: must resolve independently, to different
	-- records, with different classifications. This is the specific
	-- regression this module must never allow.
	local fumerola = findByName('Fumerola')
	local fumarole = findByName('Fumarole')
	local fumOk = fumerola ~= nil and fumarole ~= nil
		and fumerola.id ~= fumarole.id
		and fumerola.classification == 'Biological'
		and fumarole.classification == 'Geological'
	log(fumOk, 'Fumerola (Biological) and Fumarole (Geological) resolve independently, not to each other')

	return table.concat(report, '\n')
end


return p
